item.title: Ghanaian footballer killed after armed attackers open fire at team bus
item.summary: The team was returning from a match when they were attacked by "masked men wielding guns", officials say.

item.title: Iran carried out highest number of executions in decades
item.summary: Organisations warn many more people could be executed in the wake of the anti-government protests which swept Iran earlier this year.

item.title: Eight to be awarded for bravery in Bondi Junction stabbing
item.summary: Six people were killed and ten injured after a man went on a stabbing rampage in an Australian mall.

item.title: The US blockade of Iran is a gamble. Will it work?
item.summary: The US military is gambling on the blockade denying Iran vital trade - but questions remain on whether the bet will pay off.

item.title: Trump's threat raises risks and leaves predicaments unchanged
item.summary: The conflict is now a test of wills - Iran’s capacity to absorb strikes versus Trump’s tolerance for the war's costs.

item.title: Peru election drags into second day after ballot delivery fiasco
item.summary: Technical and logistical problems mean Peruvians choosing a new president and members of Congress continue to vote on Monday.

item.title: Nigeria Air Force orders investigation after dozens killed in airstrike
item.summary: There are reports that more than 100 people were killed, although the authorities have not commented.

item.title: At least 30 feared dead in crush at Haitian tourist site
item.summary: The incident occurred at a "tourist event attended by many young people", Haiti's prime minister says.

item.title: On patrol with Canadian forces securing the Arctic as global threats grow
item.summary: Across 5,200 km of Canada's Arctic, its military spent two months on a mission to meet the challenges of a changing north.

item.title: Orbán era swept away by Péter Magyar's Hungary election landslide
item.summary: Viktor Orbán's 16-year rule is over, defeated by a 45-year-old ex-party insider who convinced a majority of Hungarians to oust him.
